digest.component_or_area: inbound fetcher / projects store / apply inbound records
propositions: Inbound fetcher currently queries only a single project and runs enrichment passes against one project key, causing parent/comment/issuelink data to be silently dropped for additional projects in multi-project stores
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset
Fan-out implementation must issue one JQL pair and run all three enrichment passes per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot deduplicated by existing keys
Per-project JQL ceiling (_ACLI_CEILING) must prevent one busy project from exhausting shared query budget on behalf of others
Source project and repos must be derived at CREATE write site using jira_key prefix and project mapping lookup, without requiring signature changes or new channels through snapshot
Unseeded project mapping must fall back to single configured project behavior for byte-identical backward compatibility
